source_snapshot_semantics: current_source contains postflight source bytes only. The exact executed source/binary snapshots remain in each original launch sources.zip and runtime_binaries.zip; do not substitute current_source for those snapshots.
credential_policy: No credential stores scanned; prohibited names/trees are excluded before file content is read
self_reference_policy: Finite input manifest is inside/outside ZIP verbatim; it does not contain ZIP, delivery manifest, or part identities
